name: Parallel Dual Marching Cubes (DMC) Pipeline
definition: A parallel surface extraction pipeline that generates a quadrilateral surface mesh with full connectivity information (manifold surface, 1-ring neighbors) by combining static and dynamic lookup tables and parallel reduction algorithms, solving the problem of unconnected primitives and missing adjacency data in standard parallel extraction.
summary: The Parallel Dual Marching Cubes Pipeline generates manifold quadrilateral meshes with full connectivity from regular grids, solving standard parallel extraction issues by combining lookup tables with parallel reduction.
